text: On the authority of Abu Humaid al-Sa’idi, or on the authority of Abu Usayd - may God be pleased with them both - he said: The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: If one of you enters the mosque, let him say: O God, open for me the doors of your mercy, and when he leaves, let him say: O God, I ask you please.
